extracted.name: The Best Garlic Bread
extracted.description: This is the best garlic bread ever. It’s spread with mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, and garlic powder, then broiled until golden brown and bubbly.
instruction_lines: Mix together mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, and garlic powder in a medium bowl until thick and well combined.
Slice loaf in half lengthwise and spread the cut-side of each piece with mayonnaise mixture. Place halves on a medium baking sheet.
Cook under the preheated broiler until mayonnaise mixture is bubbling and golden brown, 2 to 5 minutes; check frequently to avoid burning.
